shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called dimensional weight and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight.
For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of Northeast Iowa, Inc. will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, so please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for large and pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping:
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.
PLEASE NOTE: electronics, glass, and other fragile items do not qualify for combined shipping.
Refused/Unclaimed Packages:
If an item is returned as unclaimed or not deliverable, we will contact the customer at the email address listed on their ShopGoodwill.com account to notify them of the return. The customer will then have seven (7) days to pay additional shipping charges for the item to be resent. If we have not received payment within those seven (7) days, the item will be relisted and prior payment will be considered a charitable contribution.

Discover natural history with this striking Orthoceras fossil stone featuring a unique starburst pattern. This Orthoceras fossil fragment is believed to originate from Morocco, a renowned source of these ancient marine fossils. The starburst orthoceras imprint stands out beautifully against the dark stone, offering both scientific intrigue and visual appeal. Perfect for display on shelves, desks, or curio cabinets, it makes a fascinating conversation starter and educational gift for those interested in geology or prehistoric life. Rest assured, this stone is naturally formed and selected for its standout fossil structure and aesthetics. Add a distinctive, museum-quality piece to your collection and enjoy lasting beauty that connects you to Earth's distant past.

description:
Natural Crystal and Geode Collection
Mixed Mineral Specimens and Polished Stones
Approximately 60 Items, Mixed Era
This comprehensive collection features a diverse array of natural geological specimens, highlighted by two significant geode slabs. The assortment includes raw geodes, polished specimens, and carved forms, making it an ideal starter set for a collector. The variety of colors and crystalline structures showcases the natural beauty of various mineral groups.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Amethyst Slab
- Purple crystal structure with natural rind
2.
Large Agate Slice
- Translucent with druzy pockets
3.
Red Jasper Pyramid
- Polished geometric form
4.
Mini Geodes (Bulk)
- Numerous cracked-open specimens
5.
Polished Gemstones
- Snowflake obsidian, green aventurine, and jaspers
6.
Raw Minerals
- Pyrite and smoky quartz chunks
Condition:
Good overall condition. Geodes are naturally fractured to reveal interiors. Slabs are structurally sound and stable. Polished pieces show smooth finishes with no significant chips. Minor surface dust present from natural storage.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage

Combined Shipping:

Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.

Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.

Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
